text: Is a hundred crunches a day the best core workout?
Your core does more than crunch. It also stops your spine from arching, twisting, and bending sideways.
Crunches and cable crunches bend the spine. Dead bugs, planks, and ab wheels stop it arching. The Pallof press stops it twisting. And suitcase carries stop it bending sideways.
Pick one from each type, a few sets a week.
